```{python}
import polars as pl
import requests #new for reading in JSON
import io       #new for reading in JSON
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```


```{python}
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json"
response = requests.get(url)
df = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))
```

```{python}
# Include and execute your code here
import polars.selectors as cs

numeric_cols = df.select(cs.numeric()).columns
numeric_cols.append("num_of_delays_carrier")

cleaned_df = (df
  # Cast delays_carrier to i64
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False)
  )
  .with_columns([
    pl.when(pl.col(col) < 0)
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(col))
    .alias(col)
    for col in numeric_cols
  ])
  .with_columns(
    cs.starts_with("minutes_delayed").fill_null(cs.starts_with("minutes_delayed").median())
  )
  .with_columns(
    cs.starts_with("num_of").fill_null(cs.starts_with("num_of").mean())
  )
)

cleaned_df.head()
```

## Which delay is the worst delay?

The worst delay out of delays due to carrier, security, and late aircraft is late aircraft, with a proportion of 0.323. Next is carrier with a proportion of 0.201. Security is the least with a proportion of 0.002. This chart and table is showing the proportion of delays each reason takes up out of all *delayed* flights, not *total* flights.

```{python}

comparison = (
  cleaned_df
  .select(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").sum().alias("total_delays_carrier"),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_security").sum().alias("total_delays_security"),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").sum().alias("total_delays_late"),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_total").sum().alias("num_of_delays_total")
  )
  .with_columns(
    proportion_delays_carrier = pl.col("total_delays_carrier") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total"),
    proportion_delays_security = pl.col("total_delays_security") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total"),
    proportion_delays_late = pl.col("total_delays_late") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total")
  )
  .unpivot(
    on=["proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late"],
    variable_name = "delay_reason",
    value_name="proportion"
  )
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("proportion")
  )
  .sort("proportion", descending=True)
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("delay_reason").str.replace("proportion_delays_", "").alias("delay_reason")
  )
)
```

```{python}
# Chart
(
ggplot(comparison, aes("delay_reason", "proportion"))
+ geom_bar(stat="identity")
+ labs(
  "Proportion of Flights Delayed by Reason",
  x="Reason",
  y="Proportion"
)
)
```

```{python}
# Table
comparison
```

### Secondary view: out of total flights

```{python}
comparison_total_flights = (
  cleaned_df
  .select(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").sum().alias("total_delays_carrier"),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_security").sum().alias("total_delays_security"),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").sum().alias("total_delays_late"),
    pl.col("num_of_flights_total").sum().alias("num_of_flights_total")
  )
  .with_columns(
    proportion_delays_carrier = pl.col("total_delays_carrier") / pl.col("num_of_flights_total"),
    proportion_delays_security = pl.col("total_delays_security") / pl.col("num_of_flights_total"),
    proportion_delays_late = pl.col("total_delays_late") / pl.col("num_of_flights_total")
  )
  .unpivot(
    on=["proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late"],
    variable_name = "delay_reason",
    value_name="proportion"
  )
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("delay_reason").str.replace("proportion_delays_", "").alias("delay_reason")
  )
  .sort("proportion", descending=True)
)
```

```{python}
# Chart: denominator is total flights
(
ggplot(comparison_total_flights, aes("delay_reason", "proportion"))
+ geom_bar(stat="identity")
+ labs(
  "Proportion of All Flights Delayed by Reason",
  x="Reason",
  y="Proportion of Total Flights"
)
)
```

```{python}
# Table: denominator is total flights
comparison_total_flights
```

## Delays per reason across each airport

Each airport follows the trend of having the highest proportion being late, the second highest being carrier, and security being very low. San Francisco has the highest proportion of delayed flights and Salt Lake City has the least.

```{python}

airport_comparison = (
  cleaned_df
  .group_by("airport_code")
  .agg(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").sum(),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_security").sum(),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").sum(),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_total").sum()
  )
  .with_columns(
    proportion_delays_carrier = pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total"),
    proportion_delays_security = pl.col("num_of_delays_security") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total"),
    proportion_delays_late = pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total")
  )
  .unpivot(
    on=["proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late"],
    index="airport_code",
    variable_name = "delay_reason",
    value_name="proportion"
  )
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("delay_reason").str.replace("proportion_delays_", "").alias("delay_reason"),
    pl.col("proportion")
  )
  .sort("proportion", descending=True)
)

```

```{python}

airport_comparison = (
  cleaned_df
  .group_by("airport_code")
  .agg(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").sum().alias("num_of_delays_carrier"),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_security").sum().alias("num_of_delays_security"),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").sum().alias("num_of_delays_late_aircraft"),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_total").sum().alias("num_of_delays_total")
  )
  .with_columns(
    proportion_delays_carrier = pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total"),
    proportion_delays_security = pl.col("num_of_delays_security") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total"),
    proportion_delays_late = pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total")
  )
  .unpivot(
    on=["proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late"],
    index="airport_code",
    variable_name = "delay_reason",
    value_name="proportion"
  )
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("delay_reason").str.replace("proportion_delays_", "").alias("delay_reason"),
    pl.col("proportion")
  )
  .sort("proportion", descending=True)
)

(
ggplot(airport_comparison, aes("airport_code", "proportion", fill="delay_reason"))
+ geom_bar(stat="identity")
+ labs(
  "Delay Proportions by Airport and Reason",
  "Which delay reasons make up the most delays out of all delay types?",
  x="Airport Code",
  y="Proportion",
  fill="Delay Reason"
  )
)

```

### Secondary view: total proportion of delayed flights separated by reason out of total flights

```{python}
airport_comparison_total_flights = (
  cleaned_df
  .group_by("airport_code")
  .agg(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").sum(),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_security").sum(),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").sum(),
    pl.col("num_of_delays_total").sum(),
    pl.col("num_of_flights_total").sum()
  )
  .with_columns(
    proportion_delays_carrier = pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier") / pl.col("num_of_flights_total"),
    proportion_delays_security = pl.col("num_of_delays_security") / pl.col("num_of_flights_total"),
    proportion_delays_late = pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft") / pl.col("num_of_flights_total"),
    proportion_delays_other = (
      pl.col("num_of_delays_total")
      - pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier")
      - pl.col("num_of_delays_security")
      - pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft")
    ) / pl.col("num_of_flights_total")
  )
  .unpivot(
    on=["proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late",
    "proportion_delays_other"],
    index="airport_code",
    variable_name = "delay_reason",
    value_name="proportion"
  )
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("delay_reason").str.replace("proportion_delays_", "").alias("delay_reason")
  )
  .sort("proportion", descending=True)
)
```

```{python}
# Chart: denominator is total flights
(
ggplot(airport_comparison_total_flights, aes("airport_code", "proportion", fill="delay_reason"))
+ geom_bar(stat="identity")
+ labs(
  "Delay Proportions by Airport and Reason",
  "Which delay reasons make up total delayed flights (including other)?",
  x="Airport Code",
  y="Proportion of Total Flights",
  fill="Delay Reason"
  )
)
```
